title: Fix audit duplicate row metadata
summary: Audit preview rows now carry backend-authored duplicate-group metadata so the Reports Duplicates filter can match returned duplicate rows from the latest audit CSV.
reason: The Reports audit table displayed the latest CSV path but duplicate rows were not marked in the row DTO, leaving the Duplicates chip with no concrete duplicate fields to match.
behavior_before: The backend counted duplicate groups separately but returned audit rows without duplicate_group metadata; the WebView Duplicates chip could show no rows unless duplicate text happened to appear in an issue field.
behavior_after: The backend marks same-leaf duplicate rows and movie-title duplicate rows with duplicate_group, duplicate_group_key, duplicate_group_size, duplicate_group_type, and duplicate_group_label while avoiding false duplicate flags for ordinary TV episode sets.
manual_validation: Live audit CSV policy check for E:\Videos\Scratch\AuditReports\audit_summary_20260707_232423.csv - passed: 3350 visible rows, 214 duplicate groups, 19 duplicate rows in the first 100 returned rows
rollback_plan: Revert src/mediapipeline/core/audit/preview_policy.py and tests/python/desktop/test_facade_audit_policy.py, refresh their generated summaries, and remove this change packet if the duplicate metadata behavior is not wanted.
notes:
Cover duplicate audit row metadata and TV episode false-positive guard.
Refresh generated summary for audit policy tests.
Add backend-authored duplicate metadata to audit preview rows.
Refresh generated summary for audit preview policy changes.
Python impact: read-only audit preview DTO shaping only; no queue writes, rerun launch, media mutation, scanner behavior, source movement, FFmpeg policy, subtitle policy, audio policy, or publish behavior changed.
